name: Root account activity
recommendation: Confirm MFA, validate that root use was expected, and review follow-on account changes.

name: Failed console login
recommendation: Review source IP, targeted identity, repeated attempts, and any successful login after failure.

name: Access key created
recommendation: Validate business need, remove unused keys, rotate as needed, and prefer temporary credentials.

name: Privilege policy changed
recommendation: Confirm approval, scope the granted permissions, and replace broad access with least privilege.

name: Public administrative ingress
recommendation: Revoke public admin access, restrict source ranges, and alert on ports 22 and 3389 exposed to the internet.

name: S3 public access control weakened
recommendation: Keep Block Public Access enabled, validate bucket policy scope, and review Access Analyzer results.

name: CloudTrail logging changed
recommendation: Validate change approval, restore logging if needed, and restrict CloudTrail administration.

name: GuardDuty configuration changed
recommendation: Document detection coverage changes and confirm GuardDuty status matches the lab plan.

name: Access denied activity
recommendation: Review whether the denied action was expected, misconfigured, or suspicious.

name: Remediation evidence
recommendation: Use this event to close the investigation timeline and document corrective action.
